purpose: Stored same-space image inputs retain packed source-over rounding; color transfers and SourceAlpha retain their shader consumer. Each SVG has its own native output, including unequal composite and merge graphs. General merges retain logical source inputs across integer/fractional offsets and unused primitives with explicit graph connections.
recipe: Decode each exact SVG as an image/svg+xml Blob and draw it onto a transparent 32x32 canvas. Three independent healthy launches per host give identical PNG bytes for all selected actuals. Windows and Linux PNG bytes also match, so references are shared by exact bytes only.
